skills.name: Spectrum Beam
skills.desc: Deals Fire DMG equal to #1[i]% of Asta's ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Meteor Storm
skills.desc: Deals Fire DMG equal to #1[i]% of Asta's ATK to one designated enemy and further deals DMG for 4 extra times, with each time dealing Fire DMG equal to #1[i]% of Asta's ATK to a random enemy.

skills.name: Astral Blessing
skills.desc: Increases SPD of all allies by #1[i] for #2[i] turn(s).

skills.name: Astrometry
skills.desc:
Gains 1 stack of Charging for every different enemy hit by Asta plus an extra stack if the enemy hit has Fire Weakness.
For every stack of Charging Asta has, all allies' ATK increases by #1[f1]%, up to #2[i] time(s).
Starting from her second turn, Asta's Charging stack count is reduced by #3[i] at the beginning of every turn.

skills.name: Miracle Flash
skills.desc: Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering battle, deals Fire DMG equal to #1[i]% of Asta's ATK to all enemies.

passives.name: Sparks
passives.desc:
Asta's Basic ATK has a 80% base chance to Burn the enemy target for 3 turn(s).
Burned enemies take Fire DoT equal to 50% of DMG dealt by Asta's Basic ATK at the start of each turn.

passives.name: Ignite
passives.desc: When Asta is on the field, all allies' Fire DMG increases by 18%.

passives.name: Constellation
passives.desc: Asta's DEF increases by 6% for every current Charging stack she possesses.
